name: Sambal Oelek
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated for SIBO as it's primarily chili peppers, vinegar, and salt without high-FODMAP ingredients like garlic or onion.
preparationTips: Check ingredient labels as some brands may add garlic or onion powder
Start with small amounts to test spice tolerance
Mix with low-FODMAP oils to create marinades
Store in refrigerator after opening for best quality
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in vitamin C from chili peppers
Contains capsaicin with potential anti-inflammatory properties
Very low in calories and carbohydrates
Provides small amounts of vitamin A
